Send one card per pull request. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] This pull request adds or changes one card.
- [ ] A reviewer can mark the rule `FAIL` in code or config.
- [ ] The card has a `FAIL` example and a `PASS` example.
- [ ] The card has a source in `borrowed_from`, or a note of first-hand experience.
- [ ] The card is in my own words.
- [ ] I ran `python3 tools/validate.py` and `python3 tools/build.py`.
- [ ] I committed the regenerated `skills/` directory.
